items.title: Earl Humphrey Interview, 1968-11-30
items.q: And, uh, Simon Maruero on bass violin. He had a six-piece band.

ctx.x: Buddy Manning on the band. Zeb, Ezeb Lenoris and Kleines. And, uh, Simon Maruero on bass violin. He had a six-piece band. Well, in case of him, he'd use the piano, well, he'd use what we call it, Tink. Xavier Batiste's piano. Yeah.
What did you think of Alfred Freddie as a trumpet player?
